title: Finalize one pending script object
summary: Recover the circular queue removal, GC relinking, mark adjustment, cached finalizer lookup and guarded VM invocation at 0x4f1bc0. The VM call is an explicit integration boundary for its custom ABI.
test_description: Compare original and recovered state byte-for-byte across singleton and multi-object queues, mark bits, missing and cached finalizers, explicit nil, and native finalizer invocation. Inspect temporary hook and threshold values, stack argument, list links, restored fields and FS head.
known_limits: The VM invocation requires an integration adapter implementing the original custom register ABI; this recovery does not implement the VM.
The original requires a nonempty valid circular queue and valid object layouts. Nonlocal errors and actual script execution are not tested.
Tested native finalizer returns a negative result to avoid unrelated VM helpers; lookup misses use an explicit nil node.
